QuestInfo.name: [Star Force] Corrupted Dragon's Nest
QuestInfo.0: #p2081006# doesn't yet realize the truth about the falling star. Tell #p2081006# what you know. \r\n
QuestInfo.1: #p2081006# was very surprised to hear about the falling star and was relieved to have avoided the worst--Horntail being affected by it. Get rid of the corrupted #o8190006# and #o8190007# monsters before things take a bad turn.  \r\n
QuestInfo.2: You got rid of some #o8190006# and #o8190007# monsters for #p2081006#. She fears the worst if Horntail started chomping at the corrupted monsters... That would be very bad for sure.\r\n

0.0: So what you're saying is... That falling star corrupted the monsters of Minar Forest? Oh dear...
0.1: But we can't just stand here and despair. We have to DO something!

yes.0: The star didn't affect Horntail, so we've avoided the worst possible situation. But now, let's get rid of the #r#o8190006##k and #r#o8190007##k monsters. Would you mind? \r\n

no.0: Where there's us, there's hope, don't you think?

1.0: Oh, you did it. You know, while you were gone, I was thinking...

yes.0: What if Horntail ATE the corrupted monsters? Goodness, things would've been bad. Very bad. Thank goodness for your brawns and my brains.

default.0: Get rid of the #r#o8190006##k and #r#o8190007##k monsters.
